Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky reiterated his willingness for a complete or partial ceasefire, including moratoriums on strikes against energy infrastructure or the Black Sea, but the Kremlin continues to reject a ceasefire. The Kremlin's current negotiating position on the war in Ukraine continues to include Moscow's longstanding demand from before the full-scale invasion that NATO change its charter and roll back its membership to NATO's former 1997 borders.

Ukrainian forces recently advanced southeast of Oleksandrivka and northeast of Hulyaipole, while Russian forces recently advanced north of Kostyantynivka.

Russian forces launched one Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missile and 88 drones against Ukraine overnight. Ukrainian forces continued their long-range strike campaign against Russian industrial infrastructure on October 27 and 28.

Ukraine's long-range strike campaign is forcing Russia to relocate its data infrastructure and augment protection measures for data centers.
